propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are currently defined in fsck_repair.py but are semantically unrelated to repair functionality and should be moved to gitutil.py

Seven production modules have inverted dependencies, importing these primitives from fsck_repair despite it being a command-layer module and gitutil being a store-layer leaf with no rebar.*-level imports
Moving the primitives to gitutil maintains module size constraints (under 800 LOC) and preserves gitutil as a stdlib-only leaf with function-local rebar imports only
Two compatibility surfaces must survive: fsck.py must continue re-exporting the symbols, and fsck_repair must keep module-level re-imports so test monkeypatching remains effective

Function-local importers in compact.py, bridge_repair.py, and tracker_maintenance.py must be repointed directly at gitutil rather than relying on fsck_repair re-exports to eliminate the inverted dependency
No test files require editing; all existing tests pass unmodified after the move, with AC1-AC7 and AC12 acceptance criteria verified
